messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the Canadian public‑holiday long weekends in 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will extend the adjacent weekend).  
(Only the federal holidays that create a three‑day weekend are shown; provincial holidays vary.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend it extends |
|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Monday Jan 2 | Dec 30 – Jan 2 |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | Apr 7 – 9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | May 20 – 22 |
| Canada Day (observed) | Monday Jul 3 | Jul 1 – 3 |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | Sep 2 – 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | Oct 7 – 9 |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | Saturday Nov 11 | Nov 11 – 13 |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | Dec 23 – 25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | Dec 24 – 26 |

*Note:*  
- **New Year’s Day** was observed on Monday Jan 2 because Jan 1 fell on a Sunday.  
- **Canada Day** was observed on Monday Jul 3 because Jul 1 was a Saturday.  
- **Remembrance Day** is a statutory holiday in most provinces; it falls on a Saturday in 2023, giving a long weekend.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
